author: Rakesh
text:
A lot of people want a clean and aesthetic desk setup.
But most of the setups we usually see are quite expensive.

What if I build one on a budget that still looks premium👀

Would you like me to make a YouTube video on it?

topReplies.author: Lakshya Lark
topReplies.text:
I'd love to see a YouTube video on it.

But there's no such thing as "budget" in this economy.

topReplies.author: Rakesh
topReplies.text: Budget doesn't really exist, it's just an amount that varies for everyone, but yeah, I'll give suggestions for this desk setup within as much budget as possible, and the desk setup is more of an idea that should be implemented—its concept might come from a video.

topReplies.author: Kushal Sarkar
topReplies.text: It feels like this video will be for GT Lab.

topReplies.text: Main Channel par chance hai depends kaosa edit hua hai mere liye 1st time hai but you know design mai kar leta hoon thoda bahut
